# ROSETTA — Universal Programming Language Transpiler (45+ Languages)

> ROSETTA (`https://rosetta-web.vercel.app`) is an AST-aware and AI-verified universal programming language transpiler capable of translating source code across 45+ programming languages — from legacy mainframes (COBOL, Fortran, Ada, Pascal) to modern systems, AI, and Web3 stacks (Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, Zig, Mojo, Carbon, Solidity, Move, Cairo).

## Core Capabilities
- **45+ Programming Languages**: Bidirectional source-to-source transpilation across Legacy, Systems, Web/Cloud, AI/Data, Functional, and Blockchain/Web3 languages.
- **Interactive Web Workbench (`/transpile`)**: Side-by-side source and target code editor with idiom-preserving translation, semantic notes, and instant verification.
- **Language Catalog (`/languages`)**: Searchable matrix of all 45+ supported languages, paradigms, type systems, and migration pathways.
- **CLI & Enterprise Documentation (`/docs`)**: Command-line interface (`rosetta transpile`) and batch repository modernization workflows.
